title: Representative normalization for abstract derived functor pairs
statement: Let B,C,T,V be abelian categories with derived categories, F:B→T and G:C→V additive, P:B→C and H:T→V exact additive, LF and LG functors on derived categories, and εF and εG their supplied homotopy-level counits. Let e:F⋙H→P⋙G be an ordinary natural transformation, M a predicate on complexes of B, and b:P_D⋙LG≅LF⋙H_D. Define normalization to mean that for every K with M(K), b⁻¹ on QK followed by LG of the exact P comparison and the actual complex counit for G equals, as a heterogeneous equality, H_D of the complex counit for F followed by the exact H comparison and Q of the complex map induced by e. The complex counits are the explicit four-factor comparisons of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. This definition chooses no derived functor, replacement or ordinary exchange.

def DerivedPairExchangeNormalization
    {B C T V : Type*} [Category B] [Abelian B] [Category C] [Abelian C]
    [Category T] [Abelian T] [Category V] [Abelian V]
    [HasDerivedCategory B] [HasDerivedCategory C]
    [HasDerivedCategory T] [HasDerivedCategory V]
    (F : B ⥤ T) [F.Additive] (G : C ⥤ V) [G.Additive]
    (P : B ⥤ C) [P.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits P] [PreservesFiniteColimits P]
    (H : T ⥤ V) [H.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits H] [PreservesFiniteColimits H]
    (LF : DerivedCategory B ⥤ DerivedCategory T)
    (LG : DerivedCategory C ⥤ DerivedCategory V)
    (εF : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ LF ⟶ F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (εG : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ LG ⟶ G.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (e : F ⋙ H ⟶ P ⋙ G) (M : CochainComplex B ℤ → Prop)
    (b : P.mapDerivedCategory ⋙ LG ≅ LF ⋙ H.mapDerivedCategory) : Prop
